* Special TabHost that allows the use of {@link Fragment} objects for * its tab content. When placing this in a view hierarchy, after inflating * the hierarchy you must call {@link #setup(Context, FragmentManager, int)} * to complete the initialization of the tab host. * *

Here is a simple example of using a FragmentTabHost in an Activity: * * {@sample development/samples/Support4Demos/src/com/example/android/supportv4/app/FragmentTabs.java * complete} * *

This can also be used inside of a fragment through fragment nesting: * * {@sample development/samples/Support4Demos/src/com/example/android/supportv4/app/FragmentTabsFragmentSupport.java * complete}
